scope: Same 40 exposed diagnosis development inputs; no resampling; no independent validation
public_resource: DDXPlus 49 disease names only; identical candidate pool for every scoring variant; no patient examples or labels retrieved
formula: (1+alpha) log P(same candidate code | full) - alpha mean log P(same code | withheld)
scoring: One forced code per request, max_tokens=1, logprobs=0. Installed vLLM V1 computes raw logprobs before allowed-token masking.
limitations: Generated 3-candidate pool may omit the answer; code likelihoods are not clinical probabilities. Patient-withheld view retains original retrieved documents and candidates.
